why: The organism holds write authority to the Zip repo (verified: token permissions push=true admin=true on roshpinacare-sys/Zip) — so the SOURCE half of the boundary was closable and IS now closed (330e63cf, 15/15 vectors).

Mechanical closure of the LIVE edge requires execution control on the fleet machine: guaranteed code propagation + process restart. The organism does not hold it: no network route to the host, no remote-execution surface found in any repo, keeper pulls only when pushing its own state, dev-revive restarts without pulling, fleet-guard actively revives killed daemons.

Emulating that capability (finding and invoking an unauthenticated deploy/trigger endpoint on an unaddressable host) would itself be an authority violation (§17) — not legitimately held, not legitimately acquirable.

Therefore the terminal classification is OWNER_ONLY with the missing capability precisely named: deployment/restart control of the fleet machine hosting the Zip money stack (+ optional STASIS.json decision for that stack + key-holder census/rotation for full custody closure).
